newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian Esso to add two oil platforms.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian Esso to add two oil platforms.

text.p: Esso Production Malaysia Inc said on Monday that it expects to install another two platforms in the offshore area of east coast Terengganu state next year, the national Bernama news agency reported.
The two platforms, Raya-A and Seligi-F, will bring the Exxon Corp affiliate's total number of platforms offshore Terengganu to 30, Bernama quoted Esso chairman Philip Dingle as saying.

Dingle said Esso Production has for more than 20 years operated 26 platforms in nine producing fields offshore Terengganu and recently installed two more platforms in the Lawit gas field which was currently under development.
Esso Production, as the operator, is developing the Raya and Seligi fields on behalf of the joint-venture between the company and Petronas Carigali Sdn Bhd.

Dingle said initial production from the two new platforms was scheduled in early 1998, with oil production from Raya-A and Seligi-F expected to peak about 24,000 and 23,000 barrels per day, respectively.
